items.headline: Anthropic's planned November IPO roadshow faces investor pushback on $1.5T valuation
items.summary: Bloomberg reported Anthropic targets a roadshow starting the week of November 9 with a listing before Thanksgiving. Reuters says four potential investors doubt the timeline and want a lower valuation than the $2T initially discussed, with $1.5T now the working range.
items.why: Anthropic's IPO, expected to be the largest AI listing ever, tests whether public markets will support trillion-dollar valuations for frontier AI companies that have never turned a profit.

items.headline: FT: Anthropic bought $3.4B in gas-fired generators from OnePWR for AI data centers
items.summary: CNBC reports the Financial Times found Anthropic agreed to buy 1.7 GW of heavy-duty gas generators from OnePWR Solutions in San Antonio for about $3.4B. The deal was struck in late September and includes engineering and construction for installation.

items.headline: Karpathy built HackerTube in about 2 hours with Claude Opus 5.5, filtering 43M HN comments into 6,454 videos
items.summary: Anthropic researcher Andrej Karpathy used Claude Code to distill 20 years of Hacker News comments into 6,454 curated tech videos on hackertube.org. No login required. He then one-shotted TristanTube (47,000 videos) in 3 minutes.

items.headline: ChatGPT holds 91% of Korea's AI app users; Claude surges 15-fold to second place
items.summary: Seoul Economic Daily reports ChatGPT reached 18.76M monthly users in Korea, up 44% year over year. Claude jumped from 140,000 to 2.1M users, moving from seventh to second. Average monthly use per person rose to 163 minutes from 110.
